caption: The drawing depicts two views of a cavalry saber and its scabbard, rendered in realistic detail on a plain off-white background. The upper object is a full view of the saber sheathed in a metallic, silver-gray scabbard with a slightly curved blade and a guard featuring three rings for suspension. The hilt is black with silver accents, including a metal knuckle guard, and has a brown leather sword knot attached to the handle by a cord. Below and slightly to the right is a detailed close-up of the saber’s hilt and guard, showing the black grip with finger grooves, the decorative silver guard, and the same brown leather sword knot, coiled and more prominently displayed. The colors in the image primarily consist of various shades of gray, black, and brown, and the drawing emphasizes metallic textures and functional design elements.
title: Sabre
